result:
All confirmed clean — nothing outside my 14-file lane touched.

**Six call sites moved:**
- `AgentSurface.tsx:340` (`GET /agent/sessions`), `:397` (`PUT /agent/sessions`), `:1563` (`POST /agent/title`), `:1689` (`POST /agent/open-terminal`) → all via a new `const scopedApi = useApi()` (kept the module `api` singleton import for the two sanctioned sites, so nothing else in the file shifted). Added `scopedApi` to the three affected effects' dep arrays.
- `chatSession.ts:1462` (`GET /agent/chat-history`) → swapped `import { api }` for `import { ApiClient }`, then `const api = new ApiClient(vault)` once near the top of `createChatSession`, built from the factory's own `vault` param — same pattern as its WS URL.
- `chatEntities.ts:2221` (`POST /agent/reveal`) → **not fixed, and I stopped rather than force it.** `revealPath` is a plain exported function (not a hook), called directly from event handlers in three files: `ChatPane.tsx:1032` and `TranscriptItem.tsx:68,197` — both owned by **T3**, not me — and `FileActions.tsx:45`, which **no task in the dependency map owns**. Unlike `rawUrl` (whose only callers were internal to `chatEntities.ts`, so `useInlineMedia`'s own `useVault()` read was enough), threading `revealPath` requires changing its exported signature, which would break three call sites outside my 13 files. I left it on the singleton rather than touch T3's files or a file nobody owns — this is the same class of gap as the `delegate-agent.test.ts` one, now surfaced for the orchestrator.

**Statement of done:**
1. Remaining singleton `api.` uses: `AgentSurface.tsx:302` `/agent/capabilities` (agnostic), `:1175` `/agent/session-model` (agnostic, keyed by claudeId), `agentPrompt.ts:68` `/agent/prompt` (agnostic, names vault in body) — all sanctioned. Plus `chatEntities.ts:2221` `/agent/reveal` — **unfixed, blocked**, see above. `chatSession.ts:1466`'s `api.` is the new local per-vault client, not the singleton.
2. `cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit` — zero errors in any of my files.
3. `npx vitest run tests/unit/delegate-agent.test.ts` — 14/14 green.
4. `git status --porcelain` — only my 14 files dirty; everything else belongs to other in-flight tasks.
